summary: Bound scoped GitHub inbound sync with monotonic operation deadlines

architecture.decision: Introduce planfile/sync/deadline.py with monotonic SyncDeadline, SyncDeadlineExceededError, and bind_backend_deadline wrapper; enforce stage and per-ticket deadline boundaries in sync_from_external and expose optional --timeout in planfile sync github without modifying planfile/sync/github.py.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit on main; --timeout is optional and defaults to 60.0s monotonic bound.

nonGoals: Modifying outbound sync or healthcheck starvation logic
delivery.outcome: Scoped GitHub inbound sync operations enforce a monotonic operation deadline across identity, fetch, and local projection and fail closed with structured JSON CLI diagnostics on expiry.

validation.evidence: 13 passed across deadline precedence/validation, CLI --timeout wiring, requester clamping, and monotonic clock checks.
All fail-closed CLI JSON exit-1, CAS/lease preservation, ReadTimeout conversion, fast TimeoutError compatibility, and partial-projection retry assertions passed.
